result.reason: The operative change reduces the automatic-renewal notice period from 90 to 30 days, satisfying the fallback maximum of 60 days while preserving the one-year renewal structure and bilateral notice right. The clause grants no unilateral price-increase right, so it does not permit increases above the fallback cap. The edit is minimal, though the drafting remains ambiguous because it refers to termination generally rather than clearly requiring non-renewal notice before the anniversary date.
